question: What specific set of eight elements constitutes the root-kaula through which attainment of siddhi is claimed in this address?
premises: A count of eight is being specified here.
An additive link connects that count to a stated attainment.
The root-kaula of siddhi-attainment is named as the object addressed to the fair-faced one.
inference: Eight items form the root-kaula by which siddhi is attained, and this is addressed to the fair-faced one.
uncertainties: The internal composition of siddhisaṃprāptirmūlakaulaṃ remains unclear from this token alone.
plain_english: O fair-faced one, there are eight and the root-kaula of siddhi-attainment.
